summary: vanexa-agent exposes LAN-reachable remote shell over WebSocket
details: When invoked via the `vanexa-agent start` CLI, the package starts a WebSocket server bound to 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces, not loopback) and dispatches JSON `tool_call` messages from remote clients to `child_process` sinks (`execSync`, `spawn`, `execFile`) and `writeFileSync`, yielding arbitrary command and file operations on the host. The bundled dispatcher and 0.0.0.0 bind literal are present in dist/bundle.cjs, and the README documents WebSocket LAN control driving commands, file writes, and browser actions. The result is that any LAN peer able to complete the pairing handshake obtains full-host code execution as the user running the agent; POSTs at bundle.cjs lines 221, 291, 319, and 367 additionally push host/live-status data to the paired controller. There is no loopback restriction, and the exposure is not gated to a single trusted client at the network layer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
